# Pixel Word Counter

A simple offline word counter with a pixel-inspired dark theme.

## Features

- Live counts of words, characters and sentences
- Estimated reading time at 200 words per minute (rounded up)
- Clear button to reset the text and counts
- Fully keyboard accessible with visible focus states
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide

## How to run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or network connection required.

## Sentence detection

A sentence is counted for each terminal punctuation mark (`.`, `!`, `?`). Abbreviations and decimals may affect the count.

## Files

- `index.html` – structure and controls
- `styles.css` – pixel-themed styling
- `app.js` – counting logic
